steps.en: Start a matching platform package and open the console
steps.zh: 启动匹配平台的安装包并打开控制台

steps.en: Choose a model, video source and detection scenario
steps.zh: 选择模型、视频源与检测场景

steps.en: Decode media and run the platform-specific inference pipeline
steps.zh: 解码视频并运行平台专用推理流水线

steps.en: Apply configured rules and deliver alarms or events
steps.zh: 应用配置规则并发送告警或事件

value.en: Operate video AI tasks without rebuilding the application layer for every model
value.zh: 不必为每个模型重建应用层，就能运维视频分析任务
